theme.vibe: Cricket Elegant - Heritage, premium, authoritative, luxurious.
theme.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) blended with classic sports heritage.

headings.description: Used for massive hero text, section headers, and quotes to establish heritage.

body.description: Modern, readable geometric sans for forms, dashboard data, and paragraphs.

typography.font_pairings_instruction: Use Cormorant Garamond for all Display/Headings, and Manrope for all functional UI and paragraph text.

background.description: Deep Pavilion Green - Dark, rich emerald/forest tones.

text.description: Ivory/Cream for main text to reduce harsh contrast of pure white, soft green-tinted grey for secondary.

accent.description: Trophy Gold - For active states, subtle borders, and key CTA buttons.

general.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections.
general.alignment: Left-aligned content dominance for elegance, except for specific centered hero or quote blocks.

marketing_pages.hero: 100vh full screen, kinetic typography (Cormorant Garamond, text-6xl to text-8xl fluid) line-by-line masked reveal. Background Parallax image with 40% opacity overlay of #0A1F16.
marketing_pages.marquee: Slow editorial marquee, uppercase Manrope, text-sm, tracking-[0.2em], #CFA858 text.
marketing_pages.about: Asymmetrical split. 4-col for sticky heading, 8-col for rich text and heritage imagery.
marketing_pages.teams_showcase: Hover-driven list or floating cards. Clean border-b (1px solid #CFA858/20).
marketing_pages.process: Vertical timeline for Trials/Selection. Minimalist connecting lines.
marketing_pages.forms: Large, spacious inputs. border-b-2 only (no full box) for a premium editorial feel, or subtly rounded full inputs.
marketing_pages.footer: Massive typography (text-[12vw] 'CAP'). Grid for office bearers (President, Secretary, etc.).

admin_dashboard.layout: Left sidebar (collapsible on mobile). Top bar for user profile.
admin_dashboard.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#CFA858/20), no heavy shadows.
admin_dashboard.tables: Shadcn UI table, dense padding. Ivory text for data, Gold for status pills (e.g., 'Registered', 'Selected').

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Provides weight to the site.
motion.reveal: Framer Motion. Elements fade in and translate-y-4 on scroll (viewport trigger).
motion.hover: Buttons use Gold background sliding in from left on hover. Links get an underline scale-x-100.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay fixed on top of the entire marketing site (pointer-events-none, opacity-5) to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-white/10 or border-[#CFA858]/20. No thick borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky navigation header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A1F16]/60 border-b border-[#CFA858]/10.

components.marketing_structure: Raw HTML + Tailwind (div, section). Do not use Shadcn for standard layout.
components.interactive: Shadcn UI for Dialog, Form, Input, Select, Table (in Admin). Strip Vercel-look, apply gold/green tokens.
components.component_path_guideline: Ensure all shadcn files are .js files (not .tsx) as the workspace is configured for .js

hero_background.description: Cricket stadium, use as dark parallax background

about_section.description: Batsman in action, masked/clipped for About section

teams_process.description: Vintage Leather ball, used as a subtle accent image or card background

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `framer-motion` for page transitions and text reveals.
Install Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' via next/font or standard HTML link.
Configure tailwind.config.js with colors: primary (#0A1F16), ivory (#F5F2EA), gold (#CFA858).
Create 2 main layouts: Marketing Layout (with grain texture, lenis, footer) and Admin Layout (sidebar, no grain, structured).
Add 'data-testid' to all form inputs, submit buttons, and admin table rows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Never use emoji characters as icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Maintain high z-index for glassmorphism headers.
Add hover states that shift text to gold and slightly lift elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing (py-24 or py-32) for premium breathing room.
No generic gradients. Rely on the Deep Green background + Gold text/borders + subtle grain.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Gold text on Deep Green passes WCAG AA. Ivory on Deep Green is excellent.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion animations with a prefers-reduced-motion check if possible.
accessibility.forms: Use explicit `<label>` elements for Registration and Contact forms.
